title: Added support for collapsible creative tabs
description: This prerequisite mod adds collapsible creative tab display, featuring simplicity, high efficiency and sleek design.
body:
![This prerequisite mod adds collapsible creative tab display, featuring simplicity, high efficiency and sleek design.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cea26a84e636e1965c8532ebf2ddec1aef8398f.png)
This prerequisite mod adds collapsible creative tab display, featuring simplicity, high efficiency and sleek design.
Adds quick submit and collapsible category bars for mods. Simple to connect, great visual effect.
